verdict.rationale: Checkout.com documents a public Unified Payments API for controlling the whole payment lifecycle. Supporting docs cover OAuth 2.0 and secret-key authentication, idempotent retries on named endpoints, adaptive rate limits, webhook management via API, and an official Node.js SDK. Missing for 10: a discoverable machine-readable OpenAPI spec (all probed paths returned 404), and independent or hands-on corroboration of API usage.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: Take complete control of the entire payment lifecycle from a single API.
The following endpoints from our API support idempotent requests, so you can safely retry them without the risk of a duplicate request
Request a payment using a token, a network token, a payment instrument, or the full card details.
